spacing.$description: Semantic spacing roles referencing the core scale (50, 100–1500). Use for padding, gaps, and layout separation.

2xs.$description: spacing-2xs — hairline gaps between tightly related elements

xs.$description: spacing-xs — tight gaps (icon next to label)

sm.$description: spacing-sm — compact padding and small stacks

md.$description: spacing-md — default gap between related items

lg.$description: spacing-lg — section padding and larger stacks

xl.$description: spacing-xl — generous breathing room inside layouts

2xl.$description: spacing-2xl — separation between major layout blocks

6xl.$description: spacing-6xl — hero and marketing block spacing
